title: Status Teams
description: A simple data pack which lets users display a status next to their name.
body:
Adds a variety of statuses next to your name.

Heavily inspired by the [Status](https://modrinth.com/mod/status) mod by [henkelmax](https://modrinth.com/user/henkelmax).

### Don't expect any updates for this pack anytime soon. Feel free to update the pack yourself :)

# Tags & Commands
Live
```
/trigger st_live
```
Recording
```
/trigger st_rec
```
AFK
```
/trigger st_afk
```
Remove Tag (Default Name)
```
/trigger st_reset
```
